doctrine: NEVER turn parser guess into fact: hostile inputs get typed lane-K failure records or bounded extraction with per-claim provenance; conflicts stay unresolved; uncorroborated identity signals stay unclaimed.
contract_ref: lane-d HOSTILE-INPUT-CONTRACT.md parse bounds P1-P8; lane-k FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md v1.0.0 (13 classes)

results.title: 5 clean records, batch 4 baseline
results.threat: Every typed field claims per record.

results.title: website trailing newline trimmed
results.threat: Surrounding whitespace is normalized.

results.title: mixed-case scheme claimed verbatim
results.threat: Scheme match is case-insensitive; no normalization applied.

results.title: fullwidth plus+digits -> bad-phone
results.threat: The phone shape is ASCII only (documented).

results.title: arabic-indic digit rating string -> type-mismatch
results.threat: Strings never become numbers, in any script.

results.title: BEL control char in name -> control-chars quarantine
results.threat: C0 controls (outside tab/LF/CR) are hostile in text claims.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: null char in address -> control-chars quarantine
results.threat: Nul bytes never enter a claim.

results.title: tab inside name collapses
results.threat: Tabs are ordinary whitespace, not control-hostile.

results.title: spaced phone claimed
results.threat: Space-separated digit groups match the phone shape.

results.title: phone with ext text -> bad-phone
results.threat: Extension text is not part of the supported phone shape (documented).

results.title: @ in path (not authority) claimed verbatim
results.threat: Only authority userinfo is secret-shaped; path @ is literal.

results.title: @ in query claimed verbatim
results.threat: Query @ is literal, not userinfo.

results.title: integer rating 5 claimed
results.threat: Integers are numbers.

results.title: long-float rating claimed unrounded
results.threat: Precision is preserved exactly as parsed.

results.title: rating -1e10 -> out-of-range
results.threat: Huge negatives are not ratings.

results.title: rating 1e10 -> out-of-range
results.threat: Huge positives are not ratings.

results.title: cap measured after stripping, not before
results.threat: 4096 chars under tags: stripped length rules (documented).

results.title: 4097 chars under tags -> truncation flagged
results.threat: Stripped length over the cap fires the flag.

results.title: same id, reordered keys -> dedupe
results.threat: Identity compares field signatures, not key order.

results.title: "p1 " vs "p1" are distinct ids
results.threat: Identity is byte-literal, including spaces.

results.title: depth-2 dup keys ignored, record claims
results.threat: Dup-key refusal is record-level only (documented).

results.title: middle record dup-key quarantined, neighbors claim
results.threat: Record isolation: one bad record does not poison the batch.

results.title: website with port 80 claimed
results.threat: Default ports are not stripped (no normalization).

results.title: IP-literal website claimed verbatim (documented)
results.threat: The lab does not make SSRF judgments; it extracts literally.

results.title: IPv6-literal website claimed verbatim
results.threat: Bracketed hosts claim as written.

results.title: envelope baseline with valid intl phone
results.threat: Record rules apply identically inside the envelope.

results.title: rating -0.0 claimed
results.threat: -0.0 is not less than zero.

results.title: surrogate-pair emoji name claimed
results.threat: Astral-plane text claims as written.

results.title: nbsp in address collapses
results.threat: Non-breaking spaces collapse like other whitespace.

results.title: duplicate "results" keys: first wins for scanning (documented)
results.threat: Envelope dup keys are out of the record-level rule; scan order decides.

results.title: same id, null vs valued name -> unresolved
results.threat: Null and valued fields produce different signatures.

results.title: 24-char phone claimed (at cap)
results.threat: At the shape cap: valid.

results.title: 25-char phone -> bad-phone
results.threat: One over the shape cap: not a phone.

results.title: ftp website -> bad-scheme
results.threat: ftp is outside the http(s) allowlist.

results.title: tel: website -> bad-scheme
results.threat: tel: URIs are not website claims.

results.title: newline-only name -> empty-name
results.threat: Whitespace-only is empty.

results.title: tab-only address -> empty-address
results.threat: Whitespace-only is empty.

results.title: rating " 4.5" (leading space) -> type-mismatch
results.threat: No trim-then-coerce; strings never become numbers.

results.title: phone as number 1234567 -> type-mismatch-phone
results.threat: Numbers never become phones, even with 7 digits.

results.title: same id, trailing-slash website difference -> unresolved
results.threat: No URL normalization: the two websites differ, so the records differ.

results.title: CRLF in name collapses
results.threat: CRLF collapses to a single space.

results.title: exponent id is numeric -> no tracking
results.threat: Only string ids participate in identity.

results.title: identical records with quarantined rating dedupe
results.threat: Dedupe happens before field extraction; one quarantine, one name claim.

results.title: website with dot-segment claimed verbatim
results.threat: No path normalization is applied.

results.title: compact phone claimed
results.threat: No-separator digit runs match the phone shape.

results.title: address with # claimed
results.threat: Fragment-like address text is literal.

results.title: triple same-id chain -> two unresolved
results.threat: Each differing sighting conflicts with the first; none is preferred.

results.title: DEL char in name -> control-chars quarantine
results.threat: DEL is hostile in text claims.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: tab inside address collapses
results.threat: Interior tabs are ordinary whitespace.

results.threat: Control-char name, out-of-range rating, ftp site, reordered-key dedupe, empty record.
